The '''BAF-999 Prototype Siege Droid''' was a prototype [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] produced by [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. BAF-999 Siege Droids were among the forces used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during their retreat from the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]].<ref name="TOR" />
